config.name: First geometry-only student feasibility pilot; not Ours final training
config.model: GeometryResidualUNet, 4 inputs, widths32/64/128, two downsamples, zero-initialized single residual head, 471841 parameters
config.augmentation: same uniform native crop and horizontal flip schedule in all3 variants; no resize, color augmentation or depth renormalization
config.base_frame_schedule: 80 independent seeded permutations of100 training frames;8000 exposures per variant, same ordered frame/crop/flip tuples; four source families only
config.joint_schedule: exactly2 natural and2 perturbed branch inputs per batch, shuffled with independent branch seed; same4000/4000 exposures; perturb source branch already contains20% no-op and crop may miss perturbation
config.precision: BF16 autocast forward, float32 residual addition/loss/parameters; no gradient scaling
config.geometry_loss: mean over valid batch pixels abs(preclamp_prediction-fixed_reference)
config.keep_loss: mean_S relu(abs(preclamp_prediction-actual_input)-epsilon); S from frozen data, excludes perturb footprint in perturbed branch; empty S yields0
config.evaluation: full native1024x436 frames, no test-time augmentation/re-alignment; both natural and fixed perturb branches on dev; train and dev at step0 and2000; record preclamp and clipped geometry MAE, fixed regions and unsupported-domain changes
config.primary_summary: unperturbed dev input, per-source valid-pixel MAE then equal weight over two dev sources; only final2000-step model is the fixed endpoint
config.checkpoint_selection: none; final only, intermediate evaluation is descriptive learning curve and does not change any run
config.abort: stop on nonfinite loss/gradient or implementation mismatch; preserve partial run, no automatic hyperparameter retry
config.scope: 150 existing frames only,100 train/50 dev; no VDA, ATB or teacher inference; no DAVIS access; no claim of convergence/generalization/Bokeh improvement from this small single-seed pilot

aggregation: pixels within each source, then equal weight across sources; two dev sources, not independent final test
caveats: One initialization seed; no statistical-significance or general-method claim.
GT targets are bounded affine-aligned labels; no post-student alignment or metric-depth accuracy claim.
150 source frames remain100 train/50 dev; 8000 exposures per run are not8000 independent examples.
No ATB outputs, real-domain adaptation or DAVIS evaluation in this training experiment.
Near-reference subset is a proxy for small original geometric error, not calibrated confidence.
